title: BuildKit metadata of an index export with attestations has no config digest, so the containerd check fails
resolution: The check reads the platform config digest from the Config entry of the manifest.json of docker image save, no longer from --metadata-file; a failed save or a manifest without one config blob fails it.

title: The containerd test stub always writes a config digest key and hides the index export case
resolution: The stub writes BuildKit's metadata without a config digest for an index and serves a saved manifest.json; tests cover differing index digests, configs, layers, a failed save, and bad manifests.

title: The containerd store behaviour of the save manifest and RootFS.Layers is unmeasured but stated as settled, and no gate names a containerd run
resolution: Design decision 3 and Risks mark the single save entry and the RootFS.Layers of the platform image as unmeasured assumptions; a containerd-store run of the check is a remaining gate.

title: The test stub still writes BuildKit metadata for a flag the script no longer passes, and its comment describes that interface
resolution: The stub no longer writes BuildKit metadata or reads a config variable, and its comment names what it models; the record says the containerd tests differ only in image IDs.

title: The build loop and compare_builds spell the image tags two ways and read the caller's locals implicitly
resolution: The build loop iterates over the two tags and compare_builds takes them as arguments.

title: The record says finish_reproducible changed, but the change leaves it unchanged
resolution: The self-check says only check_reproducible changed, plus five new helpers.

title: The new scenario has an unfinished comparison and the requirement words the config digest report differently from its scenario
resolution: The scenario's comparison is complete, the requirement names both config digests when they differ, and it has 497 characters.

title: The guide's list of failure causes leaves out a failed layer read
resolution: The guide names a failed layer read among the failures.

title: The record says both containerd stub tests have the same config and layers, but the failing one has a differing first layer
resolution: Both places now say the passing test has the same config and layers and the failing one a differing first layer; Low-only pass, fixed without another review.
